patches.note: the engine and its bind line; the paused / repaint entry (tick, selection, filter, resize, map move) goes to the engine, which reads the store itself; the shipped body stays below as the fallback (kill switch and automatic fallback)

the playing loop: the engine owns the clock (a continuous fractional tick that writes the integer tick back to the store when it changes) and draws in the map render event; the shipped loop keeps only the fps counter and the wake-up
every other consumer of y1 (minimap, picker index, fly-to) sees the unit positions the engine draws
desktop pick: the mark under the pointer as drawn (select and pin); empty ground deselects; a crowd mark moves the map in until it splits
phone pick, the same contract as the shipped handler (selection record, select, pin), a finger-sized reach
GtbgRepaint (every map move while paused) must not reset the backing store the engine sized for the device pixel ratio
the order-of-battle files the loader fetched are handed to the engine (hierarchy, designations, battalions)
